working_definition: One of three P15 optic lobe clusters identified by the authors as ganglion mother cells (dpn-, ase+), the transient progenitor between a neuroblast and two daughter neurons or glia.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Daughter cell formed through asymmetric division of a neuroblast, typically generating two postmitotic neurons.

justification: The authors call the cluster ganglion mother cells; FBbt has the generic ganglion mother cell term and no optic-lobe-specific or larval/pupal-specific GMC term (only embryonic and named embryonic/VNC GMCs, and type I/II GMC).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: A ganglion mother cell that is born of a type I neuroblast (Marques et al., 2023).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Authors do not specify neuroblast type.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00005149 ganglion mother cell (exact).
